question: Padma Shri awardee (2023) Guru K Kalyanasundaram Pillai is an exponent of which of the following classical dance genres?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Guru K Kalyanasundaram Pillai** is a renowned exponent of **Bharatnatyam**, one of the eight recognized Indian classical dance forms.
 
• **Bharatnatyam** originated in **Tamil Nadu** and is considered one of the oldest classical dance forms in India.
 
• This dance form is known for its **graceful movements, intricate footwork, and expressive gestures**, often used to narrate stories from Hindu mytho
